description: Scene files. create makes any missing folder of the path. Headless, it updates .godot's class list and starts autoloads. Operations: create: a new scene with one root node; save: save the scene as the editor holds it, or as the file loads when the editor has it closed; save_as (needs newPath): save a copy under newPath. Default create.

from.description: editor opens a closed scene in the editor and saves it from there. Left out, a closed scene is saved as the file loads. For op save.

inherits.description: A scene for the new one to inherit, such as "parts/crate.tscn". The root takes that scene's class, so rootNodeType is not given with it. For op create.

newPath.description: Where the copy goes. An existing file is refused. For op save_as.

rootNodeName.description: The root node name. Default the class name. For op create.

rootNodeType.description: The root node class, or a class_name a script declares. Default Node. For op create.

script.description: A script to attach to the root. For op create.

name: scene_create
title: Create or save a scene
